c.tagline: Volcanic peaks, hidden bays, and the gateway to the Grenadines.

taxi.fareNote: Fares are set by route/zone rather than metered; agree the price before departing, especially from the airport or ferry terminal.

emergency.note: Milton Cato Memorial Hospital in Kingstown is the main referral hospital

english.label: Easy to get by in English

hood_landmark.Arnos Vale: Arnos Vale Playing Field, Arnos Vale

avoid.reason: Keep usual watch for petty theft around the market and quiet streets after dark.

hood_desc: Compact downtown of Kingstown with the market, cathedrals, waterfront and ferry terminal to the Grenadines; suits budget travelers, business visitors and those wanting to be near shops and transport links.
The most popular beach strip on the island, with a string of small resorts facing Young Island and calm swimming water; suits leisure travelers wanting sand, snorkeling and easy restaurant access.

A quieter residential/marina area next to the yachting hub at Blue Lagoon, popular with sailors and those wanting a low-key base near dive shops and the Botanic Gardens; suits independent travelers with a rental car.

Inland area near the old E.T. Joshua airfield and sports grounds, with guesthouses and easy access to Kingstown and the airport highway; suits budget travelers and those in town for business or cricket matches.
A yachtie-favorite Grenadine island a short ferry ride from Kingstown, with a laid-back harbor town, beaches and a strong sailing culture; suits travelers wanting an island escape without flying.

water.note: Municipal water is treated, but visitors commonly stick to bottled water as a precaution.

transit.pay: Minivan and bus fares are paid in cash directly to the driver or conductor in Eastern Caribbean dollars; there is no fare card system. Ferry tickets to Bequia and other Grenadine islands are bought at the dock or booth before boarding.
transit.hours: Minivans run roughly 6am-9pm on main routes, with limited service after dark; no scheduled night buses.
transit.note: Vans display route destinations in the windshield and can be flagged down anywhere along the route.

tip.r: Not obligatory; a 10% service charge is often already added to restaurant bills, in which case extra tipping is not expected.
